name: Six shared palettes reuse all six existing earned advancement frames

One settings listener applies shared semantic tokens and rejects locked selections
Settings owns the only frame control; Appearance still offers marks and accessories
Palette text, muted labels and highlights remain legible on their panel surfaces
Theme changes never mint water, DNA, mass, upgrades, or gameplay bonuses
The encounter is optional and starts only once after reaching star scale
Exactly 7,200 active seconds complete the encounter and rewards cannot be repeated
Each thirty-minute phase releases one finite budget, including skipped-frame catchup
Paused, upgrade, photo, menu, game-over and hidden states do not advance time

Travelling outside the bridge stops new matter emission

Hidden tabs and long suspension clear stale FPS samples

Selected route labels never alternate with regular stage names on mismatched UI refreshes
